_note: THE ENFORCED SET IS NOT IN THIS FILE. `tooling/upstream/lib.mjs`'s `migrated()` derives it from `vendor/shadcn/<cli>/ui/*.tsx` — every component the pinned upstream ships a file for, minus the `exempt` names below — and `verify-parity.mjs`, `verify-variant-coverage.mjs` and `verify-public-api-docs.mjs` all read it from there. Until 2026-09-18 this file carried a hand-maintained `components` array instead, because Batches 2-6 needed a set that grew as each component was reset (implementation.md § 3.3 vs § 3.6). Batch 6 finished it at all 62, and the Codex review of `main..HEAD` pointed out what the array had become: deleting one name from it silently switched off byte-parity AND variant coverage for that component, with nothing to notice. The array is gone. What is left is the one record a directory listing cannot supply.

exempt._note: Upstream registry items with NO file to migrate. verify-parity.mjs asserts the claim — upstream must ship no ui/<name>.tsx and this repository must ship none either — so an entry here cannot become a back door out of the derived set, and the record cannot rot into a silent omission.
exempt.form: Upstream's `form` is a docs-only registry item: the CLI writes no file for it and upstream publishes no docs markdown page, because the react-hook-form wiring is documented on `field` and in the Forms guide. There is nothing to copy, patch, test or mirror, so it is neither migrated nor an extra — and it is exempt from variant coverage for the same reason (implementation.md § 5.3, MK 2026-09-18).
